name: Dreame
headline: Dreame ownership, products, manufacturing and global channel expansion
description: A source-backed profile of Dreame's private-company ownership boundary, Xiaomi history, product expansion, Suzhou manufacturing and route to market.
metaDescription: Dreame company profile: ownership, Xiaomi and MOVA relationships, leadership, products, manufacturing, channels and strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Dreame, MOVA or Xiaomi. Dreame is privately held, and historical financing announcements do not establish a complete current cap table.
founded: 2017 (official pages trace the founding team's motor work to 2015)
heroImageAlt: Dreame robot vacuums and upright wet-and-dry floor cleaners displayed in a product showroom

ownership.summary: Dreame is a privately held company founded and led by Yu Hao. A 2020 company financing announcement identified Xiaomi Corporation and Shunwei Capital as returning shareholders and said Dreame had joined the Xiaomi ecosystem in 2017; it did not identify Xiaomi as parent or controller. The current complete ownership and voting structure is not publicly disclosed. MOVA is a separate consumer brand described on its regional site as powered by Dreame Technology, but its products, apps and contracting entities should not be treated as interchangeable with Dreame.

leadership.name: Yu Hao
leadership.context: Official Dreame pages identify Yu Hao as founder; the company traces its technology roots to his team's high-speed digital motor work.

leadership.name: Ana Wang
leadership.context: Leads the company's North American business and has represented its premium robot-vacuum and retail expansion strategy.

productPortfolio.name: Robot vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: A core premium category built around navigation, obstacle avoidance, mopping and multifunction docks.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-and-dry floor cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Upright hard-floor cleaning systems spanning mainstream and premium models.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless stick vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: The high-speed-motor category that helped establish Dreame's independent brand.

productPortfolio.name: Home, yard and personal-care products
productPortfolio.positioning: A widening portfolio that now includes hair care, air care, kitchen appliances, robotic lawn mowers and robotic pool cleaners in selected markets.

manufacturingSupplyChain: Dreame's official brand history says it operates three production lines with annual throughput of one million units and can accept multi-category ODM orders.

The official contact page identifies a Dreame factory and headquarters site on Wuzhong Boulevard in Suzhou. A separate official Korean profile describes a 33,150-square-metre intelligent factory using manufacturing execution systems and automated robot-vacuum assembly.

Manufacturer-of-record can vary by category and model. Buyers should verify the product label and compliance documents rather than assume every Dreame-branded product is made by the same legal entity.
marketsChannels: Dreame's current US company page says the brand reaches more than 120 countries and regions and operates more than 4,000 physical stores, alongside ecommerce and dealer channels.
The global contact page lists localized support across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Latin America and provides a dedicated distribution contact.
The company's route to market is moving beyond marketplace-led growth toward branded retail and in-person product experience, while its product range broadens beyond floorcare.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dreame combines a fast-widening portfolio—from robot and upright floorcare into yard, pool, personal-care and home appliances—with ecommerce, distributors and a growing physical-store network. Its Xiaomi ecosystem history accelerated the early business but does not define current legal ownership. The strategic pressure is organizational: Dreame must convert rapid category launches and high marketing intensity into durable service, quality and channel economics while Roborock and Ecovacs contest the same premium floorcare and offline experience space.

developments.title: Dreame shows a broad global retail footprint
developments.summary: Dreame's current company profile reports operations across more than 120 countries and regions and more than 4,000 physical stores, marking a route-to-market expansion beyond online floorcare.

developments.title: MOVA operates as a distinct consumer brand
developments.summary: MOVA's regional company page describes the brand as founded in 2024 and powered by Dreame Technology. The relationship supports shared technology context, not the assumption that every MOVA and Dreame legal entity or customer contract is the same.

developments.title: Dreame announces Series B+ financing
developments.summary: Dreame announced a nearly RMB 100 million round led by IDG Capital and identified Xiaomi Corporation and Shunwei Capital as returning shareholders, documenting investment without establishing Xiaomi control.

developments.title: Dreame joins the Xiaomi ecosystem
developments.summary: Dreame's official history says it joined the Xiaomi Technology Ecosystem at the end of 2017. Ecosystem participation is a commercial and product relationship, not a legal ownership category.

sources.title: Smart Consumer Technology Startup Dreame Technology Raises Nearly USD 15 Million in Series B+ Funding Led by IDG Capital
